# SimManager.java Template

Fill in all `{{PLACEHOLDER}}` values from user input before writing the file.

```java
package frc.robot.utils.simulation;

import org.ironmaple.simulation.SimulatedArena;
import org.ironmaple.simulation.gamepieces.GamePieceOnFieldSimulation;
import static edu.wpi.first.units.Units.Kilograms;
import static edu.wpi.first.units.Units.Inches;
import static edu.wpi.first.units.Units.Meters;
import edu.wpi.first.math.geometry.Translation2d;

/**
 * SimManager initializes the MapleSim arena and spawns game pieces for simulation.
 * Generated by PowerLib sim skill. Edit values here or re-run the skill to regenerate.
 *
 * Robot: {{ROBOT_WEIGHT_LBS}} lbs, {{BUMPER_LENGTH_IN}} x {{BUMPER_WIDTH_IN}} in bumper
 * COF: {{WHEEL_COF}}
 * Game pieces: {{GAME_PIECE_NAMES}}
 */
public class SimManager {

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Game piece type names — add new entries here for future seasons
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    {{GAME_PIECE_ENUM_OR_CONSTANTS}}

    private SimManager() {}

    /**
     * Call this once during robot initialization when running in simulation.
     * Registers the arena and spawns all game pieces at their starting positions.
     */
    public static void initialize() {
        SimulatedArena.getInstance().resetFieldForAuto();
        spawnGamePieces();
    }

    /**
     * Respawns all game pieces. Call at the start of each auto or when resetting the field.
     */
    public static void resetField() {
        SimulatedArena.getInstance().resetFieldForAuto();
        spawnGamePieces();
    }

    /**
     * Updates the simulation arena. Call this every robot periodic loop when in simulation.
     */
    public static void update() {
        SimulatedArena.getInstance().simulationPeriodic();
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Spawn all game pieces at their field starting positions
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    private static void spawnGamePieces() {
        {{SPAWN_GAME_PIECES_BODY}}
    }
}
```

---

## How to fill {{GAME_PIECE_ENUM_OR_CONSTANTS}}

For each game piece type, generate a public static final string constant:

```java
public static final String {{NAME_UPPER}} = "{{Name}}";
```

Example for "Note":
```java
public static final String NOTE = "Note";
```

---

## How to fill {{SPAWN_GAME_PIECES_BODY}}

For each spawn location of each game piece type, generate one block.

### Cylinder game piece spawn

```java
SimulatedArena.getInstance().addGamePiece(
    new GamePieceOnFieldSimulation(
        {{NAME_CONSTANT}},                          // game piece type name
        () -> Kilograms.of({{MASS_KG}}),            // mass supplier
        Inches.of({{DIAMETER_IN}} / 2.0),           // radius (half of diameter)
        Inches.of({{HEIGHT_IN}}),                   // height
        new Translation2d({{X_METERS}}, {{Y_METERS}}) // field position
    )
);
```

### Box game piece spawn

```java
SimulatedArena.getInstance().addGamePiece(
    new GamePieceOnFieldSimulation(
        {{NAME_CONSTANT}},
        () -> Kilograms.of({{MASS_KG}}),
        Inches.of({{LENGTH_IN}}),
        Inches.of({{WIDTH_IN}}),
        Inches.of({{HEIGHT_IN}}),
        new Translation2d({{X_METERS}}, {{Y_METERS}})
    )
);
```

---

## Example — Two game piece types, multiple spawn locations

```java
private static void spawnGamePieces() {
    // Note spawns
    SimulatedArena.getInstance().addGamePiece(
        new GamePieceOnFieldSimulation(
            NOTE, () -> Kilograms.of(0.235),
            Inches.of(7.0), Inches.of(2.0),
            new Translation2d(1.5, 4.0)));
    SimulatedArena.getInstance().addGamePiece(
        new GamePieceOnFieldSimulation(
            NOTE, () -> Kilograms.of(0.235),
            Inches.of(7.0), Inches.of(2.0),
            new Translation2d(2.0, 6.5)));

    // Coral spawns
    SimulatedArena.getInstance().addGamePiece(
        new GamePieceOnFieldSimulation(
            CORAL, () -> Kilograms.of(0.18),
            Inches.of(4.0), Inches.of(3.0),
            new Translation2d(5.0, 3.2)));
}
```
